svg.title: Yusuf Eminoglu — urban planning and computational spatial science
svg.desc: A city plan with moving traffic, cyclists and pedestrians. An analytical layer sits on top: blocks extruded into volumes, a ten minute walking catchment sweeping out from a centre, blocks flagged as heat islands, and a proposed greenway and pedestrian street.

g.text: Urban planner · PhD candidate, City & Regional Planning
Computational spatial science · GIScience · urban resilience
